Closes #4441

I made the two slowest `fork_screen` tests much cheaper, but the 120 s target is missed. `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh fork_screen` now finishes in 209 s (the plan expected under 120 s). The plan's 477 s figure for the cap test alone is where the job's time went, so the group should now be well under the 8-minute target. - `r4397000_an_always_differing_candidate_forks_every_game_at_the_cap` still asserts the cap, the fork positions and the pair determinism over all 4 forks. Its 1-thread vs 4-thread tally comparison now covers one fork (16 arms) instead of four (64 arms).
